articles.title: U.S. Sheriff’s association shifts opposition stance to Clarity Act to 'neutral'
articles.snippet: The law enforcement association said it has pivoted its position regarding the Clarity Act to neutral, months after it warned against a law it said would shield crypto crime.

articles.title: South Korea targets February 2027 rollout for full tokenized securities market
articles.snippet: Financial regulators unveiled a phased roadmap moving traditional capital markets onto distributed ledgers, concluding with onchain stablecoin settlement.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETF inflows hit $3.8B in strongest three-week stretch of 2026
articles.snippet: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew nearly $1 billion in the latest week as Friday inflows stayed positive despite Bitcoin briefly falling below $79,000.

articles.title: Pineapple Financial puts $1B in mortgage records on Injective
articles.snippet: The mortgage lender plans to bring more than $10 billion in historical loans onchain, turning thousands of mortgage files into blockchain-based records.

articles.title: US law enforcement group moves to ‘neutral’ position on CLARITY Act
articles.snippet: Despite earlier opposition to the CLARITY Act over consumer protection, the National Sheriffs’ Association says it will now “step back and allow the legislative process to proceed.“
